reason: The price is lower than I feared, and a free demo with human onboarding is the right start for me, but I would book the demo, not pay this month. I don't hand my customers or my brand to 'AI co-workers' until someone shows me it works in a business like mine.
objection: Who checks what these AI managers say to my customers and prospects, and how much of my own time goes into setting them up and fixing their mistakes? I also don't know what 100 credits actually buys, so the real monthly bill is unclear.
would_change_my_mind: A demo where their Customer Success person sets it up on my own CRM and mailbox and shows me real results within a month, ideally with a reference from a similar small business in Belgium or France.
